question: A square loop enters a uniform magnetic field with velocity $v$. After some time, it starts moving out of the field with the same velocity $v$. Compare the direction of induced current in these two cases.

options.A: The direction is the same in both cases.
options.B: The direction is clockwise in both cases.
options.C: The direction is opposite in the two cases.
options.D: There is no current when leaving the field.
